role: Tests that the CloudKit upload backoff expression lets every deferred session become eligible again (regression for a bucket % period expression that deferred forever), still backs off with more failures, spreads sessions across cycles and caps the shift exponent.
types: CloudRetryProgressTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase for retry backoff progress
state: workedExampleUUID: static UUID whose stableRetryBucket is 1

flags.text: Every 'fix' test evaluates the test's own copy of the backoff expression (defers(), with literals 6 and 32) instead of CloudKitSyncManager.shouldDeferForBackoff (private, using maxBackoffExponent/maxBackoffCycles and the real pushCycleCounter); a regression in the production expression or its constants passes this suite. Only stableRetryBucket is production code here.

units.does: Re-implements the backoff test: period = min(2^min(failCount,6), 32), offset = bucket % period, defer unless (cycle+offset) % period == 0.

flags.text: Duplicates the body of CloudKitSyncManager.shouldDeferForBackoff with hard-coded caps instead of calling it.

units.does: Re-implements the old buggy expression bucket % min(2^failCount, 32) != 0.
Asserts the worked-example UUID's stableRetryBucket is 1 and the old expression defers on 1,000 repeated evaluations at failCount 1.

branches.effect: asserts oldDefers(1, 1) is true each time (constant inputs, so iterations add nothing)

units.does: For failCount 1...8 and seven bucket values, asserts some cycle within the period makes the session eligible.
